blurb.en: Stereo vowel morphing lifted from the NF-1: ten preset vowels, four editable bands, the lot under CV.
blurb.fi: Vokaalien morffaus stereona, suoraan NF-1:stä: kymmenen valmista vokaalia, neljä muokattavaa kaistaa, kaikki CV:n alla.
blurb.sv: Stereo vokalmorfning rakt ur NF-1: tio färdiga vokaler, fyra redigerbara band, allt under CV.

pull.q: What sets the Modor filter apart from other quad-bandpass filters is the ability to smoothly morph between three of these settings.

quotes.t: The filter needs a lot of harmonics to bite into to make it really shine, so saw waves or white noise are recommended.
If the levels hit too high, the built-in compressor will kick in to save your ears and the signal becomes a burst of white noise. This feature could certainly cause issues in a live context.
